Northwind Coffee takes Pay by Bank at checkout and ships each order once its charge is paid.

  1. Customer

    The shopper's details become a Straddle customer.

    customer

  2. Bank link

    The shopper connects a bank account through Bridge.

    paykey

  3. Charge

    Placing the order debits the linked account once.

    charge

  4. Status

    Signed events move the order to paid, failed or returned.

    webhook

  5. Funding

    Deposits match orders by their funding events.

    funding event
